The 12-month change was 3.3% (vs. 2.8%)

BREAKING: US June PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred inflation metric, falls to 3.7%, in-line with expectations.

Core PCE inflation fell to 3.3%, the second highest reading since October 2024.

US inflation continues to run at nearly double the Fed's 2.0% target.
